 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE E.S.INDIRESH  -7-  NC: 2024:KHC:50532  WP No. 374 of 2022
ORAL ORDER

In this writ petition, the petitioners herein are challenging the acquisition proceedings initiated by the respondent- Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board (for short, KIADB) on the ground that, the acquisition proceedings has been lapsed for not passing the award and not paying the compensation.
2. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.

Though the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submitted that, no award and compensation has been paid to the petitioners,
however, Sri. K.N.Phanindra, learned senior counsel, appearing on behalf of Smt.Vaishali Hegde,
learned counsel for respondent No.5/beneficiary, invited the attention of the Court to Annexure-AD,
wherein, the petitioners herein have received the compensation pursuant to the determination of the compensation, in terms of the Consent Award as averred in paragraph No.11 of the statement of objections, filed by the respondent No.5.
NC: 2024:KHC:50532 3.

In that view of the matter, as the petitioners have received the compensation insofar as the acquisition of the land is concerned, made in favour of respondent No.5-beneficiary, the writ petition is not maintainable in view of the judgment rendered by the Division Bench of this Court, in the case of V.T.KRISHAMOORTHY Vs. STATE OF KARNATAKA reported in ILR 1991 KAR 1183,
wherein, it is stated that, the writ petition is not maintainable challenging the acquisition proceedings, if the claimant has received the compensation from the respondent-authorities.

entities.text: V.T.KRISHAMOORTHY Vs. STATE OF KARNATAKA reported in ILR 1991 KAR 1183
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. In that view of the matter, I am of the view that, no further orders are required to be made in this writ petition and the prayer made in the writ petition does not survive for consideration.

5. It is also to be noted that, respondent No.5/beneficiary has produced the statement, cheques,
vouchers, reflecting the compensation paid to the petitioners herein, as per Annexure-R5B to R5AR.

In that view of the matter, following the declaration of law made by this Court, NC:
2024:KHC:50532 referred to above that the writ petition does not survive for consideration.
Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed.
